mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seal.secure_link (secure_link_id, consent_request_id, token_hmac, link_status, expires_at, issued_by, issued_at, version_no) VALUES (#{value.linkId}, #{value.requestId}, #{value.tokenHmac}, #{value.status}, #{value.expiresAt}, #{value.issuedBy}, #{value.issuedAt}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE seal.secure_link link SET link_status='REVOKED', revoked_by=#{actorId}, revoked_at=#{now}, revoke_reason=#{reason}, version_no=link.version_no+1 FROM seal.consent_request request WHERE request.consent_request_id=#{requestId} AND link.secure_link_id=request.current_secure_link_id AND link.link_status IN ('ISSUED','ACCESSED')
